Class SolverMultiClosedMVA

java.lang.Object
solvers.SolverMulti
solvers.multiSolverAlgorithms.SolverMultiClosedMVA
public class SolverMultiClosedMVA extends SolverMulti
Solves a multiclass closed model with the exact MVA (Mean Value Analysis) algorithm [RL80]. The implemented version is the stabilized MVA [BBC+81], which avoids the numerical instabilities of the classic MVA when the model contains load dependent stations, as described in the JMVA chapter of the JMT user manual.
Author:
Federico Granata, Stefano Omini
